evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.1 ppm near the end of the ramp.
Oxygen was 6.2 ppm during growth, preceding a sustained rise.
Oxygen rose to 14.8 ppm despite unchanged growth setpoints.
Oxygen increased further to 19.4 ppm while temperature remained 750.1 °C, argon flow 99.6 sccm, pressure 760.8 Torr, and status running; other readings remain near their expected operating values.

args.missing_evidence: Independent oxygen verification and checks of gas purity and seal integrity are needed to distinguish air ingress from contamination, outgassing, or sensor error; sample characterization is not yet available.
